lines.text: &fStaff tools. Only operators and ranks with a moderation permission see this tab.
&e&lModes
&7The drop-down at the top switches the list on the left between &fPlayers&7, &fWarps&7 and &fLetters&7. The search box above it filters whichever list is showing.
&fLetters&7 is only offered to staff who may write them.
&e&lPlayers
&7Everyone online, then everyone banned. &6⚠N&7 is warnings, &eM&7 muted, &4B&7 banned.
&7Pick a name to see their standing and act on it. Click it again to clear the pick.
&fMute&7 and &fWarn&7 only appear while the player is online. &fBan&7 and &fUnban&7 work offline too, but only for staff allowed to ban.
&7Each form lets you tick the rules broken &8- several at once &7- and add a note. The note goes into the log and is shown with a ban.
&e&lWarnings
&7Warnings never expire. The &c3rd&7 warning - and every one after - bans for a day. The warn form tells you before you confirm.
&e&lDurations
&7Type &b30m&7, &b2h&7, &b1d&7, &b1w&7 or combine them (&b1d12h&7). A bare number is minutes. &b0&7 means no end.
&e&lWarps
&7Search by name or owner. Pick a warp to see its owner, location, &creports&7 and visits.
&7Set its verdict with &fApprove&7, &fReject&7, &fOfficial&7 or &fReset&7, go there with &fTeleport&7, or &fDelete&7 it.
&e&lLetters

&f+ New letter&7 writes to every player: a title, an optional send delay, how long it stays up, an icon and the text. Press &f+&7 to attach money, an item or a command. An item is only copied from your inventory.
&fSend to all&7 sends it now, or &fSchedule&7 when a delay is set.
&7Sent letters are grouped Due, Active and Expired. Open one to &fSave&7 changes, &fWithdraw&7 it or &fSend as new&7. Changes only reach players who have not accepted it yet.
&e&lWhitelist
&7Under the player panel, for staff allowed to ban. Closing the server kicks everyone who is not staff. Type the message they see and press &fSave&7.
&e&lTPS
&7Live server speed - &a20&7 is perfect. Below &c15&7 every staff member gets a chat alert.
